title: Ông Xe Ôm Cổng Ô
location: Cổng Ô Quan Chưởng và những con phố nhỏ của phố cổ Hà Nội lúc bình minh; tối muộn, ngõ nhỏ trước nhà ông Lâm.
axis: Cổng gạch cổ ở hậu cảnh giữa khung; ông Lâm và chiếc xe máy luôn chạy từ trái sang phải màn hình; cửa cuốn nhà ông Lâm nằm bên phải màn hình.
props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn cũ, giỏ đi chợ của cụ bà, gánh hàng rong, hình xăm rồng xanh sẫm trên cẳng tay phải, sơn đỏ trên cửa cuốn.
setting: Dawn in Hà Nội's old quarter: an ancient brick city gate with a tiled roof, narrow streets of tube houses with green shutters, tangled overhead wires, street vendors with shoulder poles, pink-gold morning light.

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the old man wiping his motorbike under the brick gate arch, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old man's face over the round chrome headlamp, locked off
50mm medium shot from the side of the motorbike, slow arc
85mm close-up of the old man settling his pith helmet, locked off

clips.setting: Dawn aerial over the tiled roofs of Hà Nội's old quarter: an ancient brick city gate, tangled wires, motorbikes streaming, pink-gold light.
clips.extras: motorbike riders streaming past the gate in the distance
steps: Under the ancient brick city gate at dawn, @Lam wipes the seat of the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a cloth and is already speaking to it fondly, his face clearly visible.
@Lam keeps talking to the motorbike with a crooked grin, patting the handlebar like an old horse's neck.
@Lam leans down and taps the round chrome headlamp with one knuckle as he goes on, eyebrows raised.
@Lam keeps speaking in a teasing tone while motorbike riders stream past the gate far behind him.
@Lam polishes the round chrome headlamp in slow circles with the cloth, talking to it face to face.
@Lam breathes on the chrome and keeps talking, his face curving in its reflection.
@Lam rubs the headlamp until it gleams, still talking to it with a fond smile.
@Lam wags one finger at the headlamp as he speaks, a teasing warning in his narrow eyes.
@Lam straightens up beside the motorbike and keeps talking, tucking the cloth into his windbreaker pocket.
@Lam pats the cream seat twice and goes on, nodding toward the street.
@Lam lifts a battered green pith helmet from the handlebar and keeps talking.
@Lam says the last words with a mock-stern frown at the motorbike.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth and settles the pith helmet on his grey crew cut.
The view lifts away from the gate arch, @Lam small below swinging onto the motorbike, mouth closed, as the engine coughs awake.
Pink-gold sunrise spills across a sea of mossy tiled roofs and tangled wires while motorbikes stream past the ancient gate.
clips.sfx: a chorus of distant motorbike horns waking the streets, a faraway street vendor's call, pigeons' wings fluttering past, a cloth squeaking on chrome
clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Nào, con ngựa sắt. Hôm qua mày khục khặc cả buổi chiều, sáng nay đã khoẻ chưa? Để ông lau cái đèn cho bóng đã nào. Lát chở các cụ đi chợ, đi cho êm vào, đừng giở chứng giữa đường mà ông mất mặt đấy.
clips.tone: fond and teasing, like to an old friend

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cụ Tý lên đi, từ từ thôi, bước chân này trước. Ngồi vững chưa ạ? Ôm cái giỏ cho chắc vào. Ơ kìa, lại tiền. Cụ cất đi, cháu chở cụ như chở mẹ cháu, lấy tiền gì. Cụ muối dưa thì cho cháu một bát.

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot from the front of the motorbike on the old man turning toward the back seat, slow arc
85mm close-up of the old man looking over his shoulder, locked off
40mm medium shot from the side, the old man in front and the old lady on the back seat, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old man's crinkled smile, locked off
35mm wide shot of the motorbike rolling out from under the brick city gate, locked off

clips.extras: a tiny old lady with a conical hat and a shopping basket
steps: @Lam sits astride the old cream-colored step-through motorbike under the brick city gate, turns over his shoulder and is already speaking warmly, patting the back seat.
@Lam keeps talking gently as a tiny old lady in a conical hat steps up beside the back seat with her woven basket.
@Lam nods at each careful step and keeps fussing while she climbs on slowly by herself.
@Lam keeps talking over his shoulder as she settles and hugs her basket on her lap.
@Lam gestures at the basket and goes on, his crinkled eyes warm.
@Lam's eyebrows rise at the folded banknotes she holds out, and he keeps speaking.
@Lam shakes his head and talks on with a gentle wave of his hand, refusing the money.
@Lam keeps talking softly, his palm still raised, as the old lady slowly tucks the banknotes back into her basket.
@Lam nods with satisfaction and goes on, tapping the handlebar.
@Lam keeps speaking with a sly grin, as if sealing a deal.
@Lam adds a last little request with a playful wink over his shoulder.
@Lam keeps talking for a moment more, his crinkled eyes smiling.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth into a crinkle-eyed grin and faces forward.
The motorbike rolls out from under the brick city gate into the pink-gold morning, @Lam's mouth closed.
The old lady sits snug on the back seat hugging her basket as they putter away down the street.
clips.sfx: the motorbike engine idling, a basket handle creaking, sparrows chirping, distant horns echoing off the gate

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Gió với chả gió. Thò đuôi ra làm gì hả con? Ngủ tiếp đi, ngoan nào. Mấy chục năm rồi, còn nhớ phố à? Phố bây giờ chỉ có các bà đi chợ với trẻ con đi học thôi, chẳng ai cần đến mày nữa đâu.
clips.tone: hushed and dry, half to himself

shots.camera: 50mm medium side-tracking shot gliding alongside the rider
85mm close-up of the old man's face and bared forearm at the handlebar, tracking
50mm medium shot from the front, the rider coming toward the lens, slow pull-back
100mm extreme close-up of the grey sleeve sliding over the tattoo, tracking

clips.extras: an old street vendor woman in a conical hat with a shoulder pole of fruit baskets, standing on the far pavement
steps: @Lam rides the old cream motorbike slowly down a narrow street of tube houses as a gust flips back his windbreaker sleeve, and he glances down and is already speaking under his breath.
@Lam keeps muttering to his bare forearm, one eyebrow raised, steering with his left hand.
@Lam shakes his head at the forearm and goes on, dry and hushed.
@Lam keeps talking softly, pink-gold light flickering across his face between the houses.
The clawed tail of a dark-green dragon tattoo gleams on his wrinkled forearm just below @Lam's face as he keeps speaking to it softly.
@Lam narrows his cloudy left eye at the tattoo and goes on talking, scolding it like a child.
@Lam's lips keep moving in a hushed mutter as golden light slides across his face.
@Lam tilts his head at the tattoo and asks it something dryly, half amused.
@Lam lifts his eyes to the road and keeps talking, the motorbike rolling toward the lens.
@Lam passes an old street vendor woman with a shoulder pole on the far pavement, still murmuring.
@Lam keeps talking under his breath with a faint knowing smile.
@Lam says the last words and glances at the vendor.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth and lifts two fingers in a small salute toward the vendor.
@Lam's fingers tug the grey sleeve back down over the dragon's clawed tail.
The sleeve settles flat over the tattoo as the motorbike putters on in the morning light.
clips.sfx: the soft putter of an old motorbike engine, a shoulder pole creaking, a rush of wind flapping fabric, a single low gong-like hum fading

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Lại thì thầm. Đêm qua cũng thế, đêm kia cũng thế. Gọi cho ai mà cứ phải đợi ông ngủ mới dám gọi? Người yêu à? Thế thì đã cười. Con bé này giấu ai chứ giấu ông sao được, giọng run thế kia cơ mà.

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the old man walking his motorbike to the closed shutter, gentle tracking
85mm close-up of the old man's face tilted toward the shutter, locked off
40mm medium shot from inside the alley, the old man beside the shutter facing the lens
100mm extreme close-up of the thin line of warm light under the shutter, locked off

clips.setting: Night in a narrow old-quarter alley outside Lâm's tube house: a rolling steel shutter, wet pavement with puddles, a single yellow streetlamp, potted plants, tangled wires overhead.
steps: @Lam walks the old cream motorbike into the narrow night alley under a single yellow streetlamp, stops at his closed rolling shutter and is already speaking under his breath.
@Lam keeps muttering as he lowers the side stand with his sandal.
@Lam takes off the battered green pith helmet and keeps talking quietly, eyes on the shutter.
@Lam keeps speaking low, nodding at the thin line of warm light under the shutter.
@Lam tilts his head toward the light under the shutter as he goes on, his face lit yellow by the lamp.
@Lam narrows his cloudy left eye and keeps speaking low, listening between phrases.
@Lam asks himself a question under his breath, one grey eyebrow lifting.
@Lam answers himself with a small dry shake of the head, still murmuring.
@Lam turns his face toward the lens and keeps speaking quietly, the helmet hanging from his hand.
@Lam rubs his thumb along the helmet brim and keeps talking to himself.
@Lam shakes his head slowly as he goes on, his voice dropping.
@Lam says the last words almost in a whisper.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth and stands very still beside the shutter.
The line of warm light under the shutter flickers as someone moves inside.
A shadow passes across the line of light under the shutter, then everything goes still.
clips.sfx: a motorbike engine ticking as it cools, a faint muffled whisper behind the steel shutter, a dog barking far away, water dripping from the wires

title: Cháu Gái Và Cái App Vay Tiền
location: Gian dưới nhà ống của ông Lâm trong phố cổ Hà Nội, đêm khuya.
axis: Bàn gỗ và Mai bên trái màn hình; cầu thang dốc ở giữa hậu cảnh; giường đơn của ông Lâm ở góc trong bên phải.
props: Laptop chỉ phát sáng không chữ, điện thoại rung với màn hình sáng trống, bàn thờ nhỏ với nén hương, ngọn đèn vàng, mũ cối xanh treo trên móc.
setting: Night inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room behind a rolling steel shutter, a worn wooden table, a small family altar with incense, a single bed at the back, a steep staircase, one warm lamp.

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of the granddaughter glaring at the buzzing phone in the laptop glow, slow push-in
50mm medium shot of the granddaughter at the table, locked off
85mm close-up of her face over the phone, locked off
50mm medium shot of the granddaughter at the table, the dark bed soft behind her, slow drift

steps: Inside the narrow tube house at night, @Mai leans into the lamplight in her oversized lavender hoodie, glares at a buzzing phone with a glowing blank screen and is already speaking to it in a hushed, exasperated voice.
@Mai keeps talking to the phone, her face lit blue by the open laptop, nudging her round glasses up her nose.
@Mai taps the glowing blank screen to reject the call and goes on muttering.
@Mai keeps talking as the phone lights up and buzzes again at once.
@Mai leans closer to the phone and hisses on at it, her brow knotted.
@Mai taps the screen again with one finger, still talking under her breath.
@Mai spreads both hands in disbelief and keeps whispering.
@Mai rolls her eyes behind her round glasses and keeps complaining in a whisper.
@Mai glances at the glowing laptop and goes on, lips tight, voice low.
@Mai glances over her shoulder toward the dark back of the room and keeps whispering.
@Mai turns back to the phone and goes on, hissing at it.
@Mai says the last words through her teeth, then closes her mouth.
@Mai flips the phone face-down and keeps her palm flat on top of it, mouth closed.
@Mai glances toward the single bed at the dark back of the room, holding her breath, mouth closed.
@Mai turns back to the table, her palm still on the phone, lips pressed together.
clips.sfx: a phone vibrating hard against a wooden table, a quick soft tap on glass, muffled buzzing, a ticking wall fan
clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Số lạ nữa, khuya thế này còn gọi. Chặn số này nó gọi số khác, chặn tiếp nó lại đổi số. Một đêm mười cuộc, điên mất. Học công nghệ thông tin mà chịu chết với chúng nó. Im đi, ông mà dậy là lộ hết.

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the granddaughter at the table, the dark bed soft behind her, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of her face in the blue and amber light, very slow push-in
40mm medium shot from the side of the table, slow arc
100mm extreme close-up of her eyes above her cupped hands, locked off

steps: @Mai lifts her palm off the face-down phone, leans back from the table and is already whispering numbers to herself, the laptop's blue glow and the warm lamp lighting her face.
@Mai keeps whispering, staring at the glowing blank laptop screen.
@Mai raises one hand and folds down her thumb as she counts, still whispering.
@Mai folds down a second finger, her lips moving quickly.
@Mai keeps whispering the figures, her eyes fixed on the screen, her brow knotting.
@Mai folds down a third and a fourth finger, still whispering.
@Mai pauses between phrases and swallows, then goes on counting.
@Mai's lips tremble as she whispers on, blinking fast behind her round glasses.
@Mai shakes her head slightly, whispering the big final figure.
@Mai presses a hand to her forehead and keeps whispering.
@Mai glances toward the dark bed at the back as she whispers the last words.
@Mai finishes in a near-silent breath, then closes her mouth.
@Mai slowly presses her fingertips to her lips, eyes wide on the glowing screen.
@Mai's eyes glisten behind her round glasses.
@Mai lowers her hands to the table, squeezes her eyes shut and breathes out slowly.
clips.sfx: the muffled buzz of a face-down phone, a wall clock ticking, incense crackling softly on the altar, a slow shaky exhale
clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Mình vay có năm triệu thôi. Tuần đầu phí hồ sơ, tuần sau phí gia hạn, rồi phí nhắc nợ, phí phạt, lãi đẻ ra lãi. Ba tháng thôi mà, trời ơi, một trăm năm mươi triệu. Để ông biết thì ông ngủ làm sao được.

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the granddaughter crouched on the bottom step of the staircase, slow push-in
85mm close-up of her face with the phone at her ear, locked off
40mm medium shot from the foot of the stairs, slow arc
100mm extreme close-up of her hand lowering the phone to her knee, locked off

steps: @Mai crouches on the bottom step of the steep wooden staircase hugging her knees, the phone pressed to her ear, and is already whispering fast and pleading into it.
@Mai keeps whispering quickly, one hand cupped around the phone to muffle her voice.
@Mai nods hard as she pleads on, her face lit by the phone's pale glow.
@Mai keeps whispering quickly, promising something with small nods.
@Mai's brow knots and she asks a sharp whispered question into the phone.
@Mai listens for a beat, then shakes her head and whispers faster, her eyes squeezing shut.
@Mai's lips move fast and pleading, her eyes flicking toward the dark back of the room.
@Mai keeps whispering, tears welling behind her round glasses.
@Mai presses the phone harder to her ear and keeps pleading.
@Mai whispers on in a broken rush, her free hand gripping her knee.
@Mai begs once more in a tiny whisper, then calls softly into the phone.
@Mai finishes, closes her mouth and listens to the silent line.
@Mai slowly lowers the phone from her ear as the line goes dead, its screen fading to black.
@Mai's fingers let the phone rest on her knee and clutch the hood strings of her lavender hoodie.
@Mai's knuckles whiten around the hood strings as she holds very still.
clips.sfx: the quiet house ticking, a faint tinny buzz from the phone earpiece, the wooden step creaking
clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Vâng, em biết rồi ạ. Anh cho em thêm một tuần thôi, em đi làm thêm trả dần mà. Sao hôm nay lại tăng nữa ạ? Không, em không trốn. Anh đừng nhắn cho bạn em nữa, cả cô chủ nhiệm cũng nhận được rồi. Em xin anh đấy. Anh ơi? A lô?

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot across the dark room, the old man lying awake on the single bed in the foreground and the granddaughter at the foot of the stairs behind, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the granddaughter at the foot of the stairs, locked off
50mm medium shot from the foot of the bed on the old man, the staircase soft behind him, slow push-in

steps: @Lam lies on his back under a thin blanket in the dark with his eyes open and is already speaking softly toward the staircase, where @Mai freezes on the bottom step with the phone at her chest, mouth closed.
@Lam keeps speaking slowly, turning his head on the pillow toward the stairs.
@Lam lifts himself onto one elbow as he asks, his voice low and even.
@Lam keeps talking quietly, his narrow eyes on @Mai, who stays still with her mouth closed.
@Lam adds one more quiet remark, watching her face.
@Lam finishes and closes his mouth, and @Mai quickly wipes her eyes with her hoodie sleeve and starts answering fast with a bright forced smile.
@Mai keeps talking quickly, nodding too much, her eyes red behind her round glasses.
@Mai waves a hand toward the steep staircase as she rattles on.
@Mai tucks the phone into her hoodie pocket and keeps talking brightly.
@Mai says the last words with a too-wide smile.
@Mai finishes, closes her mouth and holds the forced smile.
@Lam lies back on the pillow and says one more gentle line toward the stairs, while @Mai hurries up the steep staircase behind him, mouth closed.
@Lam keeps speaking gently as the creak of the stairs fades above.
@Lam finishes his words softly, his eyes on the dark ceiling.
@Lam closes his mouth and stares up at the dark ceiling, his jaw slowly tightening.
clips.sfx: a soft sniff, a slow creak of the bed frame, quick light footsteps on wooden stairs, a gecko chirping on the wall

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Mai à, khuya rồi, con còn nói chuyện với ai đấy? Ông nghe tiếng con từ nãy.

turns.speaker: @Mai
turns.line: Dạ, bạn cùng lớp hỏi bài ạ. Sáng mai nó nộp đồ án. Cháu lên giường luôn đây, ông ngủ tiếp đi ạ.

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Ừ. Uống cốc nước rồi hẵng ngủ, giọng khản đặc cả rồi.

title: Sơn Đỏ Trên Cửa Cuốn
location: Con ngõ nhỏ trước nhà ống của ông Lâm trong phố cổ, đêm khuya ẩm ướt.
axis: Cửa cuốn nhà ông Lâm bên phải màn hình; Béo và đám xe máy đen bên trái; vũng nước ở giữa dưới ngọn đèn đường vàng.
props: Xô sơn đỏ, cửa cuốn sắt, chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn tròn mạ crôm dựng cạnh cửa, mũ cối xanh sờn cũ trên yên xe, bốn chiếc xe máy đen, vũng nước.
setting: Night in a narrow old-quarter alley outside Lâm's tube house: a rolling steel shutter, wet pavement with puddles, a single yellow streetlamp, potted plants, tangled wires overhead.

shots.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot of the lead rider, moving backward ahead of him
85mm close-up of the bald rider shouting over his shoulder, tracking
50mm medium shot of the lead rider braking before the shutter, slow push-in
28mm wide shot of the four motorbikes lined up before the closed shutter, locked off

clips.extras: three young men in black riding motorbikes behind him, faces in shadow
steps: @Beo rides the lead black motorbike into the narrow wet alley, headlights sweeping the walls, turns his round face toward the riders behind him and is already shouting orders, his gold front tooth flashing.
@Beo keeps shouting over his shoulder, pointing ahead with one thick arm at a cream motorbike parked by a closed shutter.
@Beo revs the throttle and bellows on as the bikes weave down the lane in single file.
@Beo keeps barking orders, water spraying from the puddles under his wheels.
@Beo thumbs the horn and shouts on, grinning wide.
@Beo jabs a thumb back at the last rider and keeps yelling.
@Beo's voice booms off the walls as he keeps shouting, his shaved lightning-bolt head gleaming.
@Beo jerks his chin toward the houses and keeps shouting, eyes on the green shutters.
@Beo slows down, still bellowing, the yellow streetlamp sliding over his face.
@Beo points at the closed rolling steel shutter ahead and keeps shouting.
@Beo shouts the last words, his fake-gold chain swinging.
@Beo finishes, closes his mouth into a smug grin and brakes before the shutter.
@Beo plants one flip-flop on the wet pavement, engine idling, mouth closed.
Four black motorbikes stand lined up before the closed shutter, three riders in black beside @Beo, engines idling.
Exhaust haze drifts through the yellow lamplight over the idling bikes.
clips.sfx: four motorbike engines revving and popping, horns blaring, tires splashing through puddles, a dog barking
clips.speaker: @Beo
clips.line: Anh em ơi, cái xe máy màu kem đỗ trước cửa cuốn kia kìa! Rồ ga lên chúng mày, bấm còi cho thật to vào! Đứa đi cuối nẹt pô liên tục cho tao, nghe chưa! Đêm nay cả cái ngõ này phải dậy xem nhà nào dám quỵt tiền Phú Quý!

shots.camera: 35mm medium low-angle shot of the bald man with the bucket, smooth lateral dolly
85mm close-up of the bald man bellowing up at the windows, locked off
50mm medium shot of the bald man walking toward the shutter, slow arc
28mm wide shot of the closed rolling steel shutter with the bald man in the foreground, locked off

steps: @Beo strides into the lamplight in flip-flops, unhooks a dented bucket of red paint from a parked black motorbike's handlebar and is already shouting up at the dark windows of the alley.
@Beo keeps bellowing, his fake-gold chain swaying over his black tank top as he turns in a circle.
@Beo waves his free arm at the shuttered windows above, shouting on with a gold-toothed grin.
@Beo jabs a finger at his own grinning face as he keeps shouting.
@Beo leers up at a window and keeps mocking loudly, his gold front tooth glinting.
@Beo spreads his arms wide and keeps shouting, the heavy bucket swinging.
@Beo asks a mocking question up at the windows, cupping a hand to his ear.
@Beo wipes his nose with the back of his hand and shouts on, eyes gleaming.
@Beo walks toward the closed rolling steel shutter, still shouting.
@Beo plants his flip-flops a few steps back from the shutter and keeps bellowing.
@Beo raises his eyebrows comically and shouts the last mocking words.
@Beo finishes, closes his mouth and lifts the bucket with both hands.
@Beo heaves the bucket forward and a glossy arc of bright red paint splashes across the empty steel shutter.
Red paint streams down the steel and pools on the doorstep.
@Beo steps back to admire it, swinging the empty bucket, mouth closed in a smug grin.
clips.sfx: a metal bucket handle squeaking, a heavy wet splash of paint across corrugated steel, paint dripping and trickling, a dog barking two houses away
clips.speaker: @Beo
clips.line: Kính thưa bà con cô bác, mở cửa sổ ra mà xem! Sinh viên trường nào ở Hà Nội cũng biết mặt anh. Vay thì vui, đến lúc trả thì trốn à? Trốn được mấy hôm hả em? Không sao, bọn anh sơn lại cửa cho, miễn phí nhé, khỏi cảm ơn!

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot from the side of the alley, the bald man on screen-left and the doorway on screen-right, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old man in the doorway, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old man onto the bald man beside the cream motorbike, locked off

steps: The red-streaked rolling shutter rattles up to reveal @Lam in his half-zipped grey windbreaker on screen-right, and @Beo on screen-left points at the house and is already speaking fast and loud, while @Lam's mouth stays closed.
@Beo keeps talking loudly, jabbing a thick finger toward the doorway from a few steps away, his chain swinging.
@Beo cocks his head and asks a mocking question, while @Lam stands still, mouth closed.
@Beo leans forward with a gold-toothed sneer and goes on.
@Beo holds up three fingers as he barks on.
@Beo finishes and shuts his mouth in a smug grin, arms spread wide.
@Lam looks up from the dripping paint and starts answering slowly in a calm low voice, his hands relaxed at his sides.
@Lam keeps speaking slowly, his narrow eyes steady and unblinking.
@Lam pauses, then goes on in the same low voice, nodding at the idling motorbikes.
@Lam keeps talking evenly, unhurried.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth and gives a small nod toward the end of the alley.
@Beo snorts and fires back a mocking question, standing beside the cream motorbike.
@Beo keeps talking fast, looking @Lam up and down.
@Beo finishes, folds his thick arms over his black tank top and closes his mouth.
@Beo eyes the battered green pith helmet on the motorbike seat beside him, lips shut, while @Lam's shoulder stays still in the foreground.
clips.sfx: a steel shutter rattling and rolling up, paint dripping onto the step, motorbike engines idling behind, a window creaking open somewhere above

turns.speaker: @Beo
turns.line: Ra rồi à? Cháu ông nợ tiền bọn tôi, ông biết chưa? Ba ngày nữa không có tiền thì lần sau không phải sơn đâu!

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Nó nợ bao nhiêu, tôi trả. Giờ thì tắt máy, về đi cho hàng xóm ngủ.

turns.speaker: @Beo
turns.line: Ông á? Ông chạy xe ôm thì lấy gì mà trả?

title: Đế Chế Phú Quý
location: Văn phòng tổng đài công ty cho vay Phú Quý trên tầng hai mươi lăm một tòa nhà kính ở Hà Nội.
axis: Dãy bàn nhân viên kéo dài từ trái sang phải màn hình; phòng sếp vách kính ở cuối phòng; Hưng bên trái màn hình, Béo bên phải.

title: Chiếc Hộp Sắt Dưới Gầm Giường

props: Hộp bánh quy sắt rỉ sét, tấm ảnh cũ ba người bạn trẻ thập niên chín mươi, điện thoại bàn cũ màu kem, mũ cối xanh, hình xăm rồng xanh sẫm.

steps: @Lam leans over the steel table under the single warm bulb in the closed shop and is already speaking briskly, while @Khoa sits listening on screen-left, mouth closed.
@Lam keeps talking, counting off the first role on his fingers.
@Lam folds down a second finger and taps his own chest with his thumb as he goes on.
@Lam folds down a third finger, pointing at @Khoa, and keeps speaking.
@Lam folds down a fourth finger and keeps talking, brisk and commanding, his face clearly visible in the warm light.
@Lam points toward the street outside as he goes on.
@Lam asks a short sharp question and lays his hand flat on the table.
@Lam closes his mouth, and @Khoa holds up a large gold flower brooch and starts answering dryly.
@Khoa keeps talking, turning the brooch in the bulb light, while @Lam listens, mouth closed.
@Khoa holds the brooch beside his face and goes on smugly.
@Khoa taps the tiny glint at the center of the brooch and keeps talking.
@Khoa wiggles the brooch like a magician and keeps talking dryly, his face clearly visible.
@Khoa lowers his voice for the last words, eyebrows raised.
@Khoa keeps the brooch raised as he finishes speaking.
@Khoa closes his mouth and raises his eyebrows at @Lam, the brooch glinting.
clips.sfx: a palm laid flat on a steel table, teacups clinking, a tiny electronic beep, the bulb humming

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Chia việc thế này. Bà ấy diễn, tôi lái xe, ông lo cái máy ghi hình, con bé ngồi ngoài xe giữ đường dây. Rõ chưa?

turns.speaker: @Khoa
turns.line: Có ngay, tôi làm từ chiều rồi. Cái trâm này có mắt, có cả tai. Thằng kia nói câu nào là cả nước nghe câu ấy.

steps: @Mai sits down at the steel table hugging her laptop and is already speaking softly to @Lam, her face clearly visible past his shoulder, while @Lam shakes with silent laughter, mouth closed.
@Mai keeps talking softly, smiling at him.
@Mai tilts her head and goes on, her eyes shining behind her round glasses.
@Mai keeps speaking warmly, her voice catching a little.
@Mai points at him with a teasing smile as she goes on.
@Mai says the last words with a little laugh.
@Mai closes her mouth into a slow smile, and @Lam wipes the corner of his eye with a knuckle and starts answering slowly with a twinkle in his narrow eyes.
@Lam keeps speaking slowly and warmly, his face clearly visible in the warm light.
@Lam raises one finger like a solemn promise as he goes on.
@Lam slips on a pair of big black sunglasses with a sly little shrug as he says the last words.
@Lam finishes and closes his mouth, grinning behind the dark lenses.
@Mai bursts out with a quick teasing question, eyes crinkling.
@Mai keeps talking fast, giggling as she points at the sunglasses.
@Mai keeps giggling through the last words.
@Mai closes her mouth, holding back a laugh, while @Lam raises his small teacup toward her in a quiet toast, mouth closed.
clips.sfx: teacups clinking, the bulb humming, crickets outside the half-down shutter

turns.speaker: @Mai
turns.line: Ba ông bà cười cứ như trẻ con. Cả năm nay cháu chưa thấy ông vui thế này. Ông cười to nhất đấy.

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Già rồi còn được đi chơi một chuyến, con ạ. Chuyến cuối, ông hứa.

turns.speaker: @Mai
turns.line: Chơi gì mà đeo kính đen ban đêm ạ? Ông định đóng phim à?
